name: HackTool - CrackMapExec Process Patterns
description: Detects suspicious process patterns found in logs when CrackMapExec is used
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.command_line:*tasklist\ \/fi\ * AND process.command_line:*Imagename\ eq\ lsass.exe*) AND (process.command_line:(*cmd.exe\ \/c\ * OR *cmd.exe\ \/r\ * OR *cmd.exe\ \/k\ * OR *cmd\ \/c\ * OR *cmd\ \/r\ * OR *cmd\ \/k\ *)) AND (user.name:(*AUTHORI* OR *AUTORI*))) OR (process.command_line:*do\ rundll32.exe\ C\:\\windows\\System32\\comsvcs.dll,\ MiniDump* AND process.command_line:*\\Windows\\Temp\\* AND process.command_line:*\ full* AND process.command_line:*%%B*) OR (process.command_line:*tasklist\ \/v\ \/fo\ csv* AND process.command_line:*findstr\ \/i\ \"lsass\"*)
